definitions.full: H1555. Golyath גָּלְיַת proper name, masculine ( conspicuous ? On ending ת compare Dr 1Sam 17:4 & Nö in Eut Nab 73 ) ( גָּלְיָת 1Chr 20:5 ) Philistine giant slain by David 1Sam 17:4 , 23 ; 21:10 ; 22:10 , but according to 2Sam 21:19 slain by Elhanan of Bethlehem ( הַלַּחְמִי בֵּית ; acc to 1Chr 20:5 Elhanan slew לַחְמִי brother of Goliath).
